purpose: r12-next-phase: the debrief and brief for the next phase: turn ruv.sgit.ai from a site about the talk into the site that offers the service, with a marketplace of providers
feedback: Dinis, 16 Oct: move these models into operational next steps: convert this website into the website that offers this service. The first two providers are Dinis and Mondweep (from the Agentics Foundation); add a place for others to join, the rules of engagement, how it will work, and a waiting list to apply; clients already have the emailed order. First write an article debrief that is also the brief for the implementation, so Dinis can check and fine-tune it, then implement. Capture screenshots of the current home page and main areas as a historical record, map every change (URLs, positioning, menu; breaking changes). Read the newsroom article that starts mapping the workflow. Three audiences: people who want to buy the service; consultants and service companies who want to be part of the marketplace; people who want to learn about ruv.sgit (who may become one of the other two). Rules of engagement: everything is open source / Creative Commons, all materials and playbooks published, anybody can do this without us and we encourage it; code created in engagements through us is open, except the client's own code and data; changes are committed back; revenue split equally between the parties (50/50, or a third each with three); billing by whoever has the client; custom arrangements possible.
